headword: {皆既|かいき}{日食|にっしょく}

definitions.explanation: A solar eclipse in which the Moon completely covers the Sun, briefly revealing the corona and darkening the sky.

examples.japanese: {皆既|かいき}{日食|にっしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I saw a total solar eclipse.

examples.japanese: ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{皆既|かいき}{日食|にっしょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何年後|なんねんご}です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many years until the next total solar eclipse?

examples.japanese: {皆既|かいき}{日食|にっしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧、⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{暗|くら}く→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: During the total solar eclipse, the sky grew dark even though it was daytime.

notes:
Composed of {皆既|かいき} (total; complete) + ⟦{日食|にっしょく}→日食：06311_nisshoku⟧ (solar eclipse).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {皆既|かいき}{日食|にっしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観測|かんそく}→観測：00183_kansoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to observe a total solar eclipse
- {皆既|かいき}{日食|にっしょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}こる→起こる：01910_okoru⟧: a total solar eclipse occurs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{金環|きんかん}{日食|にっしょく}→金環日食：29534_kinkannisshoku⟧: annular eclipse — a ring of sunlight remains around the Moon
- ⟦{部分|ぶぶん}{日食|にっしょく}→部分日食：29533_bubunnisshoku⟧: partial eclipse — only part of the Sun is hidden
